summary: Every requirement (R1-R3) and every ruling in the plan is delivered by a landed phase, and each of the 16 surviving acceptance criteria has implementing work I can point at in the merged HelmCharts tree: P1 the gate (.kubecoder/project.yaml, optional `test` Poetry group, hermetic suite plus the real-tree pass), P2 the allowlist widening, the reconciler-aware resolve() short-circuit, the discover_releases skip and the 8/4 verb partition, P3 the get_chart_args mis-keying at all three sites. The rulings' harder edges are honoured rather than drifted past — `_UPSTREAM_KEYS` untouched, `config` never refusing, V11's typo guard genuinely absent, the P1 gate-durability limitation stated rather than overclaimed — and the three entry shapes design.md specifies are each pinned by a parametrised test. No done-record admits a leftover that a phase owed, and no phase depends on something nothing produced. The one item clearing the mechanical-residue exception — main.py's module docstring listing nine of its twelve verbs, in a file P2 already touched — I fixed and committed here (HelmCharts 3c9af98, suite still 53 passed) and struck from the close-out; the remaining close-out entries are out-of-scope defects in files this slice does not touch, or sub-bar leftovers, and stay there for the operator.
